Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.service

Class ServiceSettings

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.service.ServiceSettings
public class ServiceSettings extends Object
DTO for GeoServer OWS service settings, shared across WMS/WFS/WCS/WMTS.

Covers common fields plus service-specific ones in a single class. Fields that do not apply to a given service are omitted from serialisation via @JsonInclude(NON_NULL).
